evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Calvin: 'I can run through that with you now if you had a maybe ten minutes or so, does that work?' — frames time but no explicit promise of dependable quote, and no real wait.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name (Coe), moving day (Saturday), city-to-city (not stated but destination assumed), apartment 1-bedroom ~800 sq ft — all four elicited across the call.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Calvin launches into property probing immediately: 'you're in a one bedroom apartment. Do you know the rough square footage.'
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Calvin: 'you did want all like packing done in the boxes like kitchen, you know, bathrooms, bedroom stuff' — packing acknowledged but framed as already-chosen, not offered as an option.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type ✓ (1BR apt), floor/stories ✗, rooms ✓ (bedroom, kitchen, bathroom inferred), walking distance ✓ (elevator, hallway), additional rooms ✗, special considerations ✓ (flood damage, fans in hallway), other stops ✗ — 4 of 7.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Not asked. Calvin gives a supply estimate ($189 typical, $100–50 partial) but never asks about overflow or unusual collections.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Calvin: 'for a one bedroom apartment. It usually takes two guys around five to seven hours... I would probably estimate you in the range of about $1,300 for a five hour service' — range anchored AND personalized to her partial packing and specific move details.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full: Calvin covers hourly rate ($230/2 movers + truck), supplies breakdown, no trip fees/taxes/credit card fees, 2.5-hour minimum, 15-minute increments. Transparent and complete.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Never asked. Calvin moves straight to availability: 'Do you have certain times that you're available on Saturday?'
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Not asked. No closing summary of the Two Promises.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Calvin ends with logistics confirmation only.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Calvin books the appointment without asking 'Would you like our help with your move?' — assumes the customer is already committed and moves to confirmation details.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Calvin: 'there's no deposit. We don't have any rescheduling fees or any fees, penalties at all' — rate protection framed as no-penalty rescheduling, not classic rate-lock language.

top_strength: Calvin gathered all four core discovery items early (name, day, route, size) and provided a thorough, itemized pricing breakdown with transparent fee structure and time commitment framing — the customer understood exactly what to expect.
coaching_note: Calvin never asked 'what are your biggest concerns?' or the Two Promises guarant, and skipped the explicit 'Would you like our help?' close — he assumed the customer was already buying and jumped to logistics, leaving money on the table and missing the chance to handle objections or lock in commitment.
